marketing.hxFaqDeadlineQ: When is the UAE e-invoicing deadline?
marketing.hxFaqDeadlineA: If your business is in scope, the deadlines depend on annual revenue. Below AED 50 million, appoint an accredited service provider by {smallAppoint} and go live on {smallLive}. At AED 50 million or more, appoint by {largeAppoint} and go live on {largeLive}. Statutory exclusions apply. The Ministry of Finance penalty is AED {penalty} for the initial violation, then AED {penalty} for each month or part thereof that non-compliance continues, capped at AED {cap} in any 12 consecutive months. Check the Ministry of Finance and FTA announcements for your case.
marketing.hxFaqEinvA: E-invoicing is included in every Muhasib plan. Before sending live e-invoices, appoint an accredited service provider through EmaraTax and complete onboarding with the provider. Once setup is complete, {brand} prepares eligible invoices in PINT AE format and exchanges them on the Peppol network through its built-in connection.
marketing.hxFaqVatA: Prepare and review VAT 201 in {brand}, then submit it in EmaraTax.
marketing.hxFaqAcctQ: Can my accountant work in my books?
marketing.hxFaqAcctA: Yes. Invite your accountant with the role that fits their work. Accounting firms can work across several client companies and share documents through the client portal.
marketing.hxFaqRecordsQ: Can I bring my existing records?
marketing.hxFaqRecordsA: Yes. Import supported records from CSV files, and follow our migration guides for Excel, Zoho Books, Wafeq and Mazeed.
marketing.hxFaqCardQ: Do I need a card to try it?
marketing.hxFaqCardA: No. Start a 14-day free trial of the Enterprise plan without entering card details.
marketing.hxFaqCancelA: Yes. You may cancel at any time. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period, as set out in our Terms.

marketing.hxHubScopeTitle: Who is in scope, and by when
marketing.hxHubScopeLead: The deadlines apply to businesses and government entities in scope under the UAE e-invoicing rules. Dates follow Ministerial Decision 244 of 2025, as amended.
marketing.hxHubInDesc: Business-to-business (B2B) and business-to-government (B2G) transactions are generally in scope, subject to statutory exclusions. Receiving B2B supplies can bring a business into scope even if it only sells to consumers.
marketing.hxHubOutDesc: Business-to-consumer (B2C) sales are currently outside the mandate. Statutory exclusions include sovereign government activities that do not compete with the private sector and transactions between members of the same tax group for 24 months from 1 January 2027.

marketing.hxHubFaq1Q: Who has to use e-invoicing in the UAE?
marketing.hxHubFaq1A: The mandate covers B2B and B2G transactions subject to statutory exclusions, including the 24-month exclusion for transactions within the same tax group from 1 January 2027. B2C sales are currently outside the mandate. A business that only sells to consumers can still be in scope if it receives B2B supplies. Deadlines for those in scope depend on annual revenue or government status.
marketing.hxHubFaq2A: PINT AE is the UAE data format for e-invoices, built on the Peppol international standard.
marketing.hxHubFaq3Q: Do I need to appoint a provider myself?
marketing.hxHubFaq3A: Yes. Appoint an accredited service provider through EmaraTax and complete onboarding with the provider. Confirm your TRN and enable e-invoicing in Settings. Once setup and onboarding are complete, you can send eligible e-invoices through the built-in connection in {brand}.
marketing.hxHubFaq4A: {brand} is the accounting software where you create and review your invoices. E-invoices are exchanged through an accredited service provider, built into {brand}.
marketing.hxHubFaq5A: E-invoicing is included on every plan, with no separate e-invoicing subscription from {brand}. Check the terms shown during setup for anything else that may apply.
marketing.hxHubFaq6Q: What happens if I miss the deadline?
marketing.hxHubFaq6A: The UAE Ministry of Finance sets an administrative penalty of AED {amount} for the initial violation, then AED {amount} for each month or part thereof that non-compliance continues, capped at AED {cap} in any 12 consecutive months. See the official announcement for the details.
